name: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy Tab Active5 Pro
statusNote: Listed by Atexxo; one distributor shows it as out of stock.
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy Tab Active5 Pro is a standard Samsung Galaxy Tab Active5 Pro converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, rated for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It is an Ex ec ic-rated design, and the tablet runs Android 16.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy Tab Active5 Pro, front view

otherSchemes: MIL-STD-810H listed on flyer for the converted unit (base tablet property)

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T85°C Dc

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.certifiedAccessories: Passive stylus (on request; Ex rating not stated). Four reinforced tether / anchor points on the unit; shoulder strap mentioned on the Active5 Pro flyer only. No Ex-rated keyboard, dock or charger listed

os.name: Android
os.upgradeLimit: Samsung UK: up to 8 years of firmware and maintenance updates; number of OS generations not stated. endoflife.date shows Android upgrades to 2029-05

specs.display: 10.1-inch TFT LCD, 120 Hz adaptive; Corning Gorilla Glass Victus+
specs.outdoor: Samsung quotes 600 nits (up from 480 nits on the previous model)
specs.chip: Qualcomm Snapdragon (4 nm; exact model not named on Samsung UK page)
specs.ram: 8 (256 GB model); 6 on 128 GB variants where offered
specs.hotSwap: Yes: dual hot-swap, one battery at a time (screen goes off while the battery is out)
specs.ports: USB-C (USB 3.2 Gen 1), 3.5 mm headset jack, POGO connector, microSD slot
specs.docking: POGO charging dock and POGO keyboard (sold separately); cradle for No Battery Mode
specs.gnss: GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo, QZSS (dual GPS)
specs.sim: Dual SIM: physical SIM plus eSIM (5G model)
specs.keys: Active Key (customisable for apps, barcode scanning or IT remapping)
specs.keyboard: POGO keyboard (sold separately); DeX on monitor
specs.storage: 128 GB or 256 GB, microSD up to 2 TB
specs.partNumbers: EX-TABLET-GTA5-PRO-128 (Zone 2/22, 128 GB, includes tablet); EX-TABLET-GTA5-PRO-256 (256 GB, includes tablet); EX-TABLET-GTA5-PRO-* (conversion and certification service, 'only for new tablets')

throughCase.label: Apple Pencil / stylus
throughCase.value: Passive stylus on request for glove use. S Pen use not stated

throughCase.label: Rear cameras
throughCase.value: Yes: front and rear camera preserved

throughCase.label: Touchscreen
throughCase.value: Yes (glove use via passive stylus on request)

throughCase.label: Charging
throughCase.value: USB-C charger preserved. Ex-area charging rules not stated

throughCase.label: Mounting points
throughCase.value: Four reinforced tether / anchor points; shoulder strap on request

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (Active Key is programmable for apps; Atexxo does not list PTT)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (camera-based; no dedicated scan engine)

capabilities.label: 3D scanning / LiDAR
capabilities.value: Not possible (base tablet has no depth sensor)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras retained; camera marketed as an intrinsically safe video camera)
